title: Naturally Smoky Brazilian Corn Wrap
description: A smoky, pillowy Brazilian dish featuring semolina flour, wrapped in a corn husk, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this raw-friendly recipe is a delicious and unique treat. It combines the natural smokiness of grilled corn with the comfort of a warm wrap.
instructions: Soak the corn husks in water for 30 minutes to make them pliable.
In a large bowl, combine the semolina flour, sea salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Gradually add the melted coconut oil and water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of grilled corn kernels in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal the wrap.
Wrap each piece in a corn husk, folding the sides over the filling and tying with a string.
Grill the wraps over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side, or until the corn husk is charred and the dough is cooked through.
